description: Place an Excel workbook (.xlsx or .xls) as a table, with the Microsoft Excel Import Options set without the dialog: sheet, cell range, formatted or unformatted table or tabbed text, cell alignment, decimal places, hidden cells, and whether the placed file stays linked for updates. Places at a point in text, or in a new text frame on a page

at.description: Place at a point in text (instead of frame). Where in text: a text frame's story or a story, at characterIndex (default: the end), or selection: true for the text cursor or selected text frame

characterIndex.description: Insertion point in the story, counted in characters from the start (default: the end of the story)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; its story is used

selection.description: Use the text cursor, the end of the selected text, a selected cell, or the end of a selected text frame's story

cellAlignment.description: Cell Alignment: as in the spreadsheet, or left, center, right

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places to keep

formatting.description: Table: formatted table, unformatted table, unformatted tabbed text, or format only once

frame.description: Place in a new text frame (instead of at); x, y, width and height in mm from the page's top-left corner

link.description: Keep the placed spreadsheet linked so the table can be updated from the file (Create Links When Placing Text and Spreadsheet Files)

range.description: Cell range such as A1:F20 (default: the used range of the sheet)

sheet.description: Sheet name (default: the sheet at sheetIndex)

sheetIndex.description: 0-based sheet index, used when sheet is not given

name: place_spreadsheet_table
title: Place Spreadsheet Table
